activities.name: Hanoi Old Quarter & Train Street Walk
activities.description: Wander the labyrinthine 36 ancient guild streets of Hanoi's Old Quarter, circle the tranquil Hoan Kiem Lake, and time your arrival at the famous Train Street — a narrow residential alley where a live locomotive squeezes past cafe terraces mere inches away.

activities.name: Halong Bay Overnight Luxury Cruise
activities.description: Sail through one of the world's most spectacular seascapes — thousands of towering limestone karst pillars rising from jade-green water — kayaking Ti Top Island, exploring the vast Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave, and watching sunrise over the bay from your cabin deck.
activities.duration_note: 2 days / 1 night cruise. Price varies significantly by boat tier — budget to luxury cabins available

activities.name: Fansipan Peak Summit — Trek or Cable Car
activities.description: Conquer the Roof of Indochina — Vietnam's highest peak at 3,143 meters — either via a rigorous 2-day jungle trek through cloud forest and alpine meadows, or via the world's longest three-rope cable car system for a dramatic aerial ascent.
activities.duration_note: Cable car is half-day; full trek is 2 days. Price range reflects cable car vs. guided trek

activities.name: Muong Hoa Valley Ethnic Village Trek
activities.description: Hike through the breathtaking cascading rice terraces of the Muong Hoa Valley to reach the traditional stilthouse villages of the Black H'mong and Red Dao ethnic minorities — experiencing weaving, indigo dyeing, and highland hospitality firsthand.
activities.duration_note: 1-day or 2-day options available with overnight homestay

activities.name: Ha Giang Loop Motorbike Expedition
activities.description: Ride one of Southeast Asia's most dramatic road circuits — the hair-raising Ma Pi Leng Pass carved into sheer cliff faces above the Nho Que River, the ancient Dong Van Stone Plateau, and remote ethnic border villages that feel completely untouched by tourism.
activities.duration_note: 3 to 4 days. IDP required to ride solo — hire a local Easy Rider if unlicensed to avoid confiscation

activities.name: Trang An Subterranean Boat Tour
activities.description: Board a hand-rowed sampan to glide silently through a UNESCO-listed landscape of dramatic limestone karsts, threading through a series of dark river caves and emerging beside ancient temples and rice paddies — the 'Halong Bay on land'.

activities.name: Mua Caves Dragon Peak Climb
activities.description: Ascend 500 steep, jagged stone steps carved into the limestone ridge of Mua Caves to reach a panoramic summit crowned by a dragon statue — the view over the winding Ngo Dong River and flooded rice paddies below is one of Vietnam's most iconic.

activities.name: Ban Gioc Waterfall Bamboo Raft Ride
activities.description: Drift by bamboo raft right to the edge of Vietnam's most spectacular waterfall — a massive, multi-tiered cascade straddling the China-Vietnam border, so wide it stretches over 300 meters and roars with the force of an inland sea during wet season.

activities.name: Ba Be Lake Kayaking & Stilt Village Stay
activities.description: Paddle across Vietnam's largest natural freshwater lake — entirely surrounded by ancient primary rainforest, limestone cliffs, and waterfalls — then spend the night in a traditional Tay ethnic stilt house on the water's edge.
activities.duration_note: 1 to 2 days with optional overnight homestay in stilt village

activities.name: Cat Ba Deep-Water Soloing & Rock Climbing
activities.description: Scale the stunning limestone karst walls of Lan Ha Bay by deep-water soloing — climbing with no ropes, falling directly into the emerald sea below — or hike the rugged jungle ridgelines of Cat Ba National Park for wildlife and panoramic bay views.

activities.name: Perfume Pagoda Pilgrimage & Cave Shrine
activities.description: Take a serene rowing boat along a peaceful river flanked by limestone peaks, then ride a cable car up the sacred Huong Tich mountain to explore one of Vietnam's most revered Buddhist cave shrines — a complex of pagodas and grottoes built into the cliff face.

activities.name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre Show
activities.description: Watch the ancient Vietnamese art of water puppetry — puppeteers hidden behind a bamboo screen maneuver wooden characters across a flooded stage, enacting scenes of rice farming, dragon dances, and legendary folklore to live traditional music.

activities.name: Pu Luong Nature Reserve Waterwheel Trek
activities.description: Hike through one of Northern Vietnam's most pristine and uncrowded valleys — passing traditional waterwheels, bamboo forest paths, and the stilted villages of the White Thai minority, with terraced paddy fields cascading down every hillside.
activities.duration_note: 1 to 2 day options with overnight homestay

activities.name: Mai Chau Valley Cycling
activities.description: Cycle through one of Vietnam's most idyllic river valleys — vast flat emerald paddy fields punctuated by clusters of traditional White Thai stilt houses, with easy flat terrain and friendly village encounters just 3 hours from Hanoi.

activities.name: Dong Xuan & Long Bien Night Markets
activities.description: Dive into the raw, electric atmosphere of Hanoi's largest historic trading markets — Dong Xuan's packed indoor wholesale halls overflowing with textiles and goods, and the Long Bien night market sprawling under the ancient railway bridge with street food and local produce.

activities.name: Bun Cha & Egg Coffee in the Old Quarter
activities.description: Track down the real Hanoi Bun Cha — charcoal-grilled pork patties and sliced pork belly served in a warm sweet-sour dipping broth alongside rice noodles and a mountain of fresh herbs — at Bun Cha Huong Lien. Finish with Ca Phe Trung egg coffee at the original Cafe Giang.

activities.name: Sapa Highland Hotpot & Mountain Pig Roast
activities.description: Warm up in the cool mountain air of Sapa with a bubbling hotpot loaded with fresh highland greens and locally farmed salmon, or feast on Lon Cap Nach — a free-range spit-roasted 'under-arm' pig cooked whole over open coals by H'mong villagers.

activities.name: Com Chay Crispy Rice & Goat Meat Feast
activities.description: Taste Ninh Binh's two celebrated specialties — Com Chay, a crispy deep-fried rice crust topped with savory pork or goat gravy, and Thit De Nui, tender mountain-grazed goat meat prepared lime-cured or grilled over charcoal with fresh herbs.

activities.name: Bia Hoi Junction Plastic Stool Beer Night
activities.description: Pull up a tiny plastic stool at the legendary Bia Hoi Junction on Ta Hien Street — the crossroads of the Old Quarter's backpacker social scene — and drink the world's cheapest freshly brewed draft beer (Bia Hoi) for as little as 25 cents a glass alongside locals and travelers.

activities.name: Binh Minh Jazz Club & The Lighthouse Bar
activities.description: Experience Hanoi's surprisingly sophisticated late-night scene — live jazz performances by local and visiting musicians at the intimate Binh Minh Jazz Club behind the Opera House, or craft cocktails and an artsy crowd at The Lighthouse bar in the Old Quarter.

activities.name: War Remnants Museum & Reunification Palace
activities.description: A powerful, unflinching half-day through modern Vietnamese history — the War Remnants Museum's harrowing photo archives and military hardware, followed by the eerily preserved 1975 Reunification Palace where the fall of Saigon unfolded in real time.

activities.destination: Cu Chi, Ho Chi Minh City
activities.name: Cu Chi Tunnels Underground Exploration
activities.description: Crawl through the 250-kilometer Viet Cong tunnel network hidden beneath the jungle — a multi-level subterranean city of sleeping quarters, field hospitals, and command centers where guerrilla fighters lived and fought for years during the Vietnam War.
activities.location: Cu Chi, Ho Chi Minh City

activities.name: Cai Rang Floating Market Dawn Boat Tour
activities.description: Rise before dawn to navigate hundreds of wooden boats loaded with tropical fruits, vegetables, and hot meals trading on the river — vendors hang their wares from tall poles as the morning mist rises over one of the Mekong's most vibrant floating markets.
activities.duration_note: Depart by 5:00 AM for best market activity

activities.name: Phu Quoc Island Boat Trip & Hon Thom Cable Car
activities.description: Spend a full day on Phu Quoc's clearest southern reefs — snorkeling coral gardens, visiting the remote Starfish Beach, and riding the world's longest non-stop cable car over the sea to Hon Thom Island for its pristine beaches and water park.

activities.name: Mui Ne Sand Dunes ATV & Fairy Stream
activities.description: Blast across towering white and rust-red coastal sand dunes on ATVs at sunrise or sunset, then walk barefoot up the Fairy Stream — a shallow red clay canyon winding through surreal eroded sandstone formations to a hidden waterfall.

activities.name: Ben Thanh Market & Street Food Square
activities.description: Navigate the iconic covered Ben Thanh Market — a Saigon institution since 1914, packed with textiles, lacquerware, spices, and souvenir stalls — then spill out into the surrounding street food square for grilled skewers, fresh sugar cane juice, and banh mi.

activities.name: Con Dao Prison History & Marine Park Diving
activities.description: Visit the notorious French and American colonial prison complex — one of Vietnam's most sobering historical sites — then dive the country's most pristine and untouched marine park, teeming with whale sharks, hawksbill turtles, and untouched coral reefs.
activities.duration_note: 1 to 2 days including flights or ferry from HCMC

activities.name: Saigon River Sunset Dinner Cruise
activities.description: Board a modern speedboat or a luxury dinner vessel to watch the Saigon skyline erupt in lights at dusk — skyscrapers, river traffic, and glittering bridges reflected on the water as you glide past the historic waterfront.

activities.name: Can Gio Mangrove Biosphere Speedboat Tour
activities.description: Race through a UNESCO-listed coastal mangrove biosphere reserve by speedboat, navigating waterways through dense swamp forest home to saltwater crocodiles, then dock at the famous Monkey Island for a wild troop of macaques.
activities.location: Can Gio, Ho Chi Minh City

activities.name: Vung Tau Ferry & Christ the King Statue Climb
activities.description: Hop the fast ferry from Saigon's harbor to the coastal city of Vung Tau, then climb 847 steps inside the massive Christ the King statue — emerging onto the outstretched arms for panoramic views over the South China Sea.

activities.name: Tra Su Cajuput Forest Skiff Ride
activities.description: Glide silently on a narrow skiff over a thick green carpet of floating water lettuce through a flooded cajuput forest canopy alive with thousands of storks, cormorants, and rare waterbirds — one of the Mekong Delta's most serene and otherworldly natural experiences.
activities.duration_note: Best visited September to November during the floating water season

activities.name: Bitexco Skydeck & Cafe Apartment Walk
activities.description: Ascend the 49th floor of the iconic Bitexco Financial Tower helipad skydeck for a bird's-eye view of Saigon's sprawling grid, then walk to the famous 9-story Cafe Apartment building on Nguyen Hue — each floor a different indie cafe with its own personality.

activities.name: Ba Den Mountain Cable Car & Cao Dai Temple
activities.description: Ascend the highest peak in Southern Vietnam by cable car to the towering Lady Buddha statue, then visit the extraordinary Cao Dai Holy See — the most ornate and visually spectacular religious temple in Vietnam, blending Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism.

activities.name: Saigon Vintage Vespa Street Food Tour
activities.description: Ride pillion on a lovingly restored vintage Vespa through the electric high-density grids of Districts 1, 3, 4, and 5 — stopping at hole-in-the-wall kitchens, steaming noodle stalls, and rooftop street food markets that only locals know.

activities.name: Phu Quoc Pepper Farm & Fish Sauce Factory Tour
activities.description: Tour the island's traditional Phu Quoc pepper farms — the most prized pepper in Vietnam — then visit a working fish sauce factory with massive centuries-old wooden barrels fermenting the world-class Nuoc Mam that is exported globally.

activities.name: Com Tam Broken Rice & Hu Tieu Street Feast
activities.description: Start with Com Tam — broken rice topped with a sweet-glazed grilled pork chop, shredded pork skin, steamed egg meatloaf, and a side of nuoc cham at any smoky street cart — then follow with Hu Tieu Nam Vang pork and seafood noodle soup for a complete Saigon food initiation.

activities.name: Mekong Elephant Ear Fish & Fermented Hotpot
activities.description: Feast on Ca Tai Tuong — a whole elephant ear fish fried vertically until the skin crackles, then broken apart and rolled in rice paper with herbs — alongside a bubbling Lau Mam fermented fish hotpot loaded with sesbania flowers and local Mekong river greens.
activities.location: Can Tho / Chau Doc, Mekong Delta

activities.name: Phu Quoc Bun Quay & Grilled Sea Urchin
activities.description: Slurp Bun Quay — the island's signature stirred noodles with fresh pounded shrimp and squid paste, customized with your own kumquat-chili dipping sauce — then move to a beachside grill for fresh sea urchins topped with scallion oil and crispy shallots.

activities.name: Bui Vien Walking Street & Chill Skybar
activities.description: Start on the neon chaos of Bui Vien Walking Street — Saigon's backpacker entertainment corridor of cheap beers, roaring music, and shoulder-to-shoulder crowds — then escape to the sophisticated Chill Skybar or Social Club Rooftop Bar for cocktails above the city lights.

activities.name: The Alley Speakeasy & District 1 Bar Crawl
activities.description: Discover Saigon's thriving speakeasy culture — The Alley Cocktail Bar & Kitchen hides behind an unassuming entrance in District 1, serving exceptional craft cocktails to a stylish crowd. Continue through the cluster of innovative bars and rooftop lounges packed into District 1's backstreets.

activities.name: Sailing Club Phu Quoc Beach Club Night
activities.description: Dance on the sand at Sailing Club Phu Quoc — the island's premier beach club with live fire dancing, resident and international DJs, and a lively international crowd directly on one of Vietnam's most beautiful beaches.
